title: Primary, Secondary and Tertiary Sources
skills: distinguish primary, secondary, and tertiary sources
classify sources according to their role in research
evaluate the strengths and limitations of different source types
select appropriate sources for academic inquiry and evidence-based writing
alignment_note: Explains the differences among primary, secondary, and tertiary sources and the distinct roles each plays in research. Supports information literacy, source evaluation, research planning, evidence selection, and academic writing across high school English courses.
